copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app

howto.what: 装上后,助手会新增一个 Discord 机器人入口,可在 Discord 私信或服务器频道中收发消息。需要先创建 Discord 应用并粘贴 Bot Token。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Discord 机器人、接入 Discord 频道,或提到需要 Discord 集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我加一下 Discord 频道
say.note: 会开始配置 Discord 机器人并接入频道。

say.text: 把对话接到 Discord 上
say.note: 会配置并验证 Discord 连接。

say.text: 让助手也能在 Discord 里回复我
say.note: 会引导完成 Discord 应用和令牌配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, the assistant gains a Discord bot entry point and can send/receive messages in Discord DMs or server channels. You need to create a Discord application and paste the Bot Token.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Discord bot, connect a Discord channel, or mentions needing Discord integration.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel for me.
say_en.note: Starts configuring the Discord bot and channel.
Configures and verifies the Discord connection.

say_en.text: Let the assistant reply on Discord too.
say_en.note: Guides through Discord app and token setup.
